channel.title: Omrano The Scorpion Dev - Studio Devlog & Releases
channel.description: Official announcements, game releases, and devlogs from indie game and app developer Omrano The Scorpion Dev.

item.title: Paws & Platters is open for business
item.description: Build your own cozy pet café, serve adorable customers, and grow your restaurant with upgrades and idle earnings. Playable now on itch.io!

item.title: Lineburst is live on itch.io
item.description: The 8x8 block puzzler is ready to play with five modes, satisfying combos, and offline support.

item.title: I'm working on Shadow Engine
item.description: Shadow Engine is a data-driven framework for creating tycoon and idle games in Godot 4.7, with tools for venues, economies, upgrades, staff, customers, and production chains.

item.title: Turf Bag: Alley Mafia playable release
item.description: Pack, merge, and position weapons in a tactical bag while rival alley gangs grow stronger each wave. Playable on itch.io!
